principles: A required document must perform the stated documentary function; title alone is not dispositive.
A material conflict in required data is a discrepancy when it affects the documentary requirement.
Authenticated evidence is identified by exact bytes, SHA-256, byte length, issuer, and version.
Retrieval failure, byte-length mismatch, or hash mismatch is not an adverse semantic verdict.
Only the bounded semantic question is subject to GenLayer nondeterministic consensus.
scope_notice: Synthetic operational ruleset. This fixture does not claim to implement UCP 600 or eUCP.
